listings.title: Chevening Scholarships 2027/28 (Pakistan)
listings.description: UK Government's global scholarship programme for one-year taught master's courses in the UK. Applications are open to Pakistani applicants for the 2027/28 intake until 6 October 2026, 11:00 UTC (4:00 pm Pakistan time).
listings.eligibility: See the full eligibility criteria at chevening.org/eligibility before applying.

listings.title: Deputy Director (IT) / Senior Manager IT (BPS-18)
listings.description: Enquiries & Anticorruption Establishment, Services General Administration & Coordination Department. 1 post (open merit). Age limit 28-35. Apply online at spsc.gov.pk. Application fee: Rs. 500 by official challan (PSID) through the 1Bill option, as stated in the advertisement. Closing date 23 Oct 2026; online applications accepted until 5:00 PM.
listings.eligibility: Bachelor in Information Technology or Computer Science (16 years education), at least second division or equivalent CGPA, from a HEC-recognised university; plus 5 years' experience in a relevant field (implementation and management of IT projects and operations).
